searchText: Order of steps were switched to make this more obvious: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8790 Note, we decided on ACD last week that the focus of the next devnet would be 7702 + all existing EIPs in devnet-2. I think most of our testing on devnet-1 has completed, so once 7702 is ready we're ready to launch devnet-3. What PRs need to go in before 7702 is considered "ready" for devnet-3? This is not mentioned explicitly in the EIP, but I assume the designated address pointed to by the 7702'd address should become warm, right? yes, i will make it explicit in the EIP Cool 😄 Could you also fix this mini typo? `For example, EXTCODESIZE would return the size of the code pointed to by address instead of 24 which would represent the delegation` (24 -> 23) yes, thank you

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Note, we decided on ACD last week that the focus of the next devnet would be 7702 + all existing EIPs in devnet-2. I think most of our testing on devnet-1 has completed, so once 7702 is ready we're ready to launch devnet-3. 

What PRs need to go in before 7702 is considered "ready" for devnet-3?

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: This is not mentioned explicitly in the EIP, but I assume the designated address pointed to by the 7702'd address should become warm, right?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: yes, i will make it explicit in the EIP

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
Cool 😄

Could you also fix this mini typo? `For example, EXTCODESIZE would return the size of the code pointed to by address instead of 24 which would represent the delegation` (24 -> 23)
